decimal.name: supplierScore
decimal.title: Supplier score
decimal.help: Weighted average of the supplier indicators computed over the rolling period configured in the Supply Chain app.

decimal.name: supplierOtdRate
decimal.title: On-time delivery rate (%)
decimal.help: Percentage of purchase order lines fully received on or before their estimated receipt date, over the rolling period.

decimal.name: supplierConformityRate
decimal.title: Reception conformity rate (%)
decimal.help: Percentage of receptions without any non-compliant line, over the rolling period.
